def select_peer_for_motivation(current_user_id,
                               user_emotional_state,
                               peer_database):
    """
    Return a *single* peer record (or None) that will be displayed to the
    current learner as a social‑comparison benchmark.
    The choice follows two complementary strategies:
        1️⃣ Aspiration Target  – a slightly higher‑performing peer.
        2️⃣ Relatability Target – a peer whose metrics are close to the learner’s.
    """
    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2.1  Load the current learner’s own performance profile
    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    learner_profile = fetch_user_profile(current_user_id)   # from your DB
    learner_perf   = learner_profile["performance_score"]
    learner_progress = learner_profile["recent_progress"]
    learner_engage   = learner_profile["engagement_score"]
    learner_sentiment = learner_profile["sentiment_score"]

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2.2  Decide WHICH STRATEGY to use (based on emotional state)
    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Simple heuristic – you can replace it with a small ML model later.
    #   *high confidence* → Aspiration
    #   *low confidence / stress* → Relatability
    sentiment   = user_emotional_state["sentiment"]
    stress      = user_emotional_state["stress_index"]
    typing_speed_delta = user_emotional_state["typing_speed"] - learner_profile["baseline_typing_speed"]
    engagement  = user_emotional_state["engagement"]

    # ---- Decision rule ----
    if (sentiment > 0.3 and stress < 0.3 and typing_speed_delta > 0):
        strategy = "aspiration"
    else:
        strategy = "relatability"

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2.3  Filter peers that we are allowed to show
    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    now = datetime.utcnow()
    eligible_peers = [
        p for p in peer_database
        if p["consent_to_share"]
        and (now - p["last_active"]).days <= 30          # active enough
        and p["peer_id"] != current_user_id               # never self‑compare
    ]

    if not eligible_peers:
        return None      # fallback – no peer shown

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2.4  Helper: score how well a peer matches a given strategy
    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    def aspiration_score(peer):
        """
        Prefer:
          • performance just above learner (but not too far)
          • visible recent progress (shows momentum)
          • positive sentiment (inspirational tone)
        """
        perf_gap   = peer["performance_score"] - learner_perf
        # We want a gap in a sweet‑spot 5‑15 % above learner
        gap_score  = max(0, 1 - abs(perf_gap - 0.10) / 0.10)   # 1 at 10 % gap
        prog_score = peer["recent_progress"]                # higher = better
        senti_score= (peer["sentiment_score"] + 1) / 2      # 0‑1 scale
        # Weighted sum (tune weights later)
        return 0.5 * gap_score + 0.3 * prog_score + 0.2 * senti_score

    def relatability_score(peer):
        """
        Prefer peers that look *almost identical* to the learner:
          • performance within ±5 %
          • similar engagement
          • similar sentiment
        """
        perf_diff  = abs(peer["performance_score"] - learner_perf)
        engg_diff  = abs(peer["engagement_score"] - learner_engage)
        sent_diff  = abs(peer["sentiment_score"] - learner_sentiment)

        engg_score = max(0, 1 - engg_diff / 0.10)   # allow a bit larger window

        prog_bonus = 0.1 * peer["recent_progress"]

        return 0.4 * perf_score + 0.3 * engg_score + 0.2 * sent_score + prog_bonus

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2.5  Rank peers according to the selected strategy
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

        scored = [(aspiration_score(p), p) for p in eligible_peers]
    else:   # relatability

    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    # Randomly pick one from the elite bucket – this avoids the same
    # peer being shown every single time while preserving the intended
    # motivational direction.
